alkylation_concentration.evidence: Samples were reduced with 5 mM TCEP for 15 minutes at room temperature and alkylated in the presence of 10 mM iodoacetamide for 30 minutes in the dark.

cleavage_agent.evidence: Pellets were resuspended in 200 mM EPPS, pH 8.5 and digested at room temperature for 14 h with LysC protease at a 100:1 protein-to-protease ratio.
Trypsin was then added at a 100:1 protein-to-protease ratio and the reaction was incubated for 6 h at 37°C.

collision_energy.evidence: The hrMS2 stage consisted of fragmentation by higher energy collisional dissociation (HCD, normalized collision energy 35%) and analysis using the Orbitrap (AGC 200%, maximum injection time 120 ms, isolation window 0.5 Th, resolution 30,000 with TurboTMT activated).

fractionation_method.evidence: We fractionated the pooled, labeled peptide sample using BPRP HPLC 105 and an Agilent 1260 pump equipped with a degasser and a UV detector (set at 220 and 280 nm wavelength).
